policy_name: Heavy Duty Industrial Equipment & Power Tools Policy
start_conditions: Commences upon equipment dispatch and registration in commercial distributor portal.
exclusions: Abnormal overload beyond specified torque limits
Normal consumable wear (carbon brushes, chuck teeth, power cords)
Tool dropped into wet concrete slurry or submerged in solvent
Serial plate defaced, stamped over, or removed
repair_conditions: Tool must be submitted to accredited regional warranty depot with complete original gear casing intact.
replacement_conditions: Unit replacement approved only for catastrophic gearbox fracture occurring within initial 6 months of delivery.
hard_fail_rules: Operating hydraulic or pneumatic system without manufacturer approved lubrication
Serial plate completely defaced, drilled out, or altered
Defect caused by documented mechanical overload exceeding tool duty-cycle rating
Disassembly performed by non-certified workshop facility
warning_rules: Tool operating hours exceed scheduled preventative maintenance cycle
High frequency heavy vibration marks observed on motor casing
manual_review_rules: Discrepancy in recorded operating duty hours versus date of purchase
Ambiguous diagnostic report on whether failure was carbon brush wear or motor defect
Dual-model agreement is Uncertain or Disagreement
